claims.statement: Cities developed around monumental mud-brick temples; administrative practices changed with writing on clay and the use of cylinder seals.

evidence.locator: Uruk period timeline and key events, ca. 4000–3100 BCE
evidence.note: Approximate regional chronology, not the lifespan of a single city. Administrative changes developed within the period, not all at its beginning.
